import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def feature_rf_ratio_score(df):
    result = df[['row_id']].copy()
    # Recency/Frequency 比值 - 越低越好（最近献血且频次高）
    # 使用log变换处理长尾分布
    rf_ratio = df['Recency'] / (df['Frequency'] + 1e-10)
    result['rf_ratio_score'] = np.log1p(rf_ratio)
    return result

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def feature_avg_donation_interval(df):
    result = df[['row_id']].copy()
    # 平均献血间隔 = (Time - Recency) / (Frequency - 1)
    # 对于Frequency=1的情况，无法计算间隔，设为NaN（首次献血者）
    interval = np.where(
        df['Frequency'] > 1,
        (df['Time'] - df['Recency']) / (df['Frequency'] - 1),
        np.nan
    )
    result['avg_donation_interval'] = interval
    return result

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def feature_habit_formed_flag(df):
    result = df[['row_id']].copy()
    # 献血>=4次的人形成稳定献血习惯 (RULE_004, EXP_04)
    result['habit_formed_flag'] = (df['Frequency'] >= 4).astype(int)
    return result

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def feature_long_no_donation_flag(df):
    result = df[['row_id']].copy()
    # 步骤1: 根据RULE_003(流失预警)，超过12个月未献血且总频次<3为流失风险
    # 但仅使用Recency>12作为长期未献血的信号，正类中仅12.4%属于此群体，负类中40.7%
    result['long_no_donation_flag'] = (df['Recency'] > 12).astype(int)
    return result

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def feature_active_donor_flag(df):
    result = df[['row_id']].copy()
    # 步骤1: 根据RULE_005(活跃献血者)，献血频率(Frequency/Time)超过0.3次/月且最近6个月内献过血
    freq_rate = df['Frequency'] / df['Time'].clip(lower=1)
    # 步骤2: 同时满足两个条件：频率>0.3次/月 且 Recency<=6
    result['active_donor_flag'] = ((freq_rate > 0.3) & (df['Recency'] <= 6)).astype(int)
    return result
